tools.name: spatial_list_quirks
tools.description: Query Spatial 3D display and AR glasses quirk profiles (XREAL, VITURE, Rokid, RayNeo, Odyssey 3D). Free tier.

tools.name: spatial_link_budget
tools.description: Solve VESA CVT-RB2 timing and check HDMI 1.4/2.0/2.1 FRL, DP 1.2/1.4/2.1 UHBR, and USB-C bandwidth with DSC 1.2 8bpp floor. Free tier.

tools.name: spatial_edid_inspect
tools.description: Decode base64 or hex EDID 1.4, CTA-861, and DisplayID 2.0/2.1 binaries, verify checksums, and match quirks. Metered ($0.005/call or Polar Pro).

tools.name: spatial_edid_patch
tools.description: Synthesize checksum-valid Full-SBS 1080p60/120 or RGB 4:4:4 EDID patch + macOS DisplayOverride plist. Metered ($0.01/call or Polar Pro).

tools.name: spatial_lenticular_optics
tools.description: Compute dynamic eye-tracked slanted-lenticular shader calibration uniforms for glasses-free 3D panels. Metered ($0.005/call or Polar Pro).
